title: Signals and Queries: Token-Efficient Agentic Context Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.29326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: User-facing LLM agents must identify which behavioral policies apply at each turn, but evaluating every policy with an LLM is costly. We introduce Signals and Queries (S&Q), a lightweight first-stage relevance filter developed for Parlant 4.0 that removes at least 30% of candidate policies before downstream evaluation while preserving high recall. For each policy, an LLM generates activating examples and hard negatives offline. An independent logistic classifier trained on their embeddings then predicts relevance using embeddings and vector dot products, with no per-turn LLM calls. This shifts expensive relevance evaluation to a smaller candidate set, while allowing each policy's classifier to be updated independently. Evaluated against 9,144 LLM-judge relevance labels covering 254 $\tau^2$-bench conversation prefixes and 36 airline policies, S&Q achieves higher precision than top-K and cosine-threshold retrieval at every evaluated recal

translated_title: 信号与查询：高效利用Token的智能体上下文发现
translated_abstract: 面向用户的LLM智能体必须确定每一轮对话中适用的行为策略，但用LLM评估每个策略的成本很高。我们提出了信号与查询（Signals and Queries，S&Q），这是一个为Parlant 4.0开发的轻量级第一阶段相关性过滤器，能在下游评估之前剔除至少30%的候选策略，同时保持高召回率。对于每个策略，由LLM离线生成激活样例和困难负样本，然后基于这些样本的嵌入训练独立的逻辑回归分类器，利用嵌入和向量点积预测相关性，无需每轮调用LLM。这将昂贵的相关性评估转移到了更小的候选集上，同时允许每个策略的分类器独立更新。基于涵盖254个τ²-bench对话前缀和36个航空策略的9,144个LLM评判相关性标签进行评估，S&Q在所有评估的召回率水平上都比top-K和余弦阈值检索方法取得更高的精确率。
tldr: 该论文提出S&Q方法，利用LLM离线生成激活样例与困难负样本训练独立逻辑回归分类器，在无需每轮LLM调用的情况下高效剔除至少30%的无关候选策略，在保持高召回率的同时显著降低了智能体策略相关性评估的Token成本。
en_tdlr: S&Q introduces a token-efficient first-stage relevance filter that trains independent logistic classifiers on offline-generated activating examples and hard negatives, removing at least 30% of candidate policies without per-turn LLM calls while preserving high recall.
